description: This file defines the LeaveRequestService class, which manages leave request operations such as status changes, workflow approvals, permission checks, and retrieval of detailed leave requests within the OrangeHRM leave management plugin.

classes.name: LeaveRequestService
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling leave request operations, including status updates, workflow actions, permission checks, and detailed retrieval in the OrangeHRM leave plugin.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestDao
methods.description: Gets an instance of LeaveRequestDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: _changeLeaveStatus
methods.description: Internal method to change the status of multiple Leave objects, handling entitlement adjustments and status updates.

methods.name: _notifyLeaveStatusChange
methods.description: Dispatches events corresponding to leave status changes based on the workflow action.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestAllowedWorkflows
methods.description: Retrieves allowed workflow actions for a leave request based on employee, leave type, status, and logged-in employee number.

methods.name: isLeaveRequestActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is allowed on a leave request given the employee, leave type, status, and action type.

methods.name: generateIncludeRolesForLeaveWorkflowByEmployee
methods.description: Determines the roles to include for workflow permission checks based on whether the user is acting on their own request.

methods.name: generateLeaveStatusByLeaveType
methods.description: Generates the leave status string with a prefix if the leave type is marked as deleted.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestActions
methods.description: Returns a list of available actions for a leave request based on current status and user permissions.

methods.name: changeLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a leave request and notifies system components of the change.

methods.name: changeLeaveStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a single leave entity and dispatches notification events.

methods.name: changeLeavesStatus
methods.description: Bulk updates statuses of multiple leaves and associated leave requests, with notifications.

methods.name: groupLeaves
methods.description: Groups leaves by their parent leave request ID.

methods.name: getDetailedLeaveRequests
methods.description: Retrieves detailed leave request objects, including their associated leaves, for a list of leave requests.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestsMap
methods.description: Creates a map of leave requests keyed by their IDs.

methods.name: getAllLeaveStatusesAssoc
methods.description: Returns an associative array of leave statuses, cached after first retrieval.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusNameByStatus
methods.description: Returns the status name given a status code.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusByName
methods.description: Returns the status code corresponding to a status name.

methods.name: getLeaveStatusesByNames
methods.description: Converts a list of status names into their respective status codes.

methods.name: getDetailedLeaves
methods.description: Creates detailed leave objects from leaves and their parent request leaves for display.
